title: What the $54 million buys
subtitle: The five largest lines; two smaller ones round out the $54 million
alt: Bar chart of the five largest lines in Central Health's 54 million dollars of new mental health investments for fiscal 2026-27: 33.1 million dollars for 22 inpatient psychiatric beds and 10 psychiatric emergency department bays, 16 million dollars to plan and launch a mental health crisis care center including 3 million for a sobering center, 1.5 million for justice-involved health and community-based complex primary care, 1 million for an additional crisis care team and 1 million for long-acting injectable medications; two smaller lines, 1 million to expand medication-assisted treatment and 400 thousand dollars for psychiatric emergency services through Integral Care, are not shown
source: Central Health, via Austin Current and Community Impact
